answer: Instead of letting one vouch last forever, build the trust graph as decaying credit: each vouch starts at 100 points and loses 12% per epoch, worth only about 28 points after ten epochs unless renewed by fresh work. An attacker spinning up 50 fake identities must keep 50 vouches alive, each backed by a 4 POA bond locked 30 days, while one fake earns at most 0.8 POA per epoch — the umber shadow of cheap fakes fades before reaching its zenith. If a trusted node is compromised, its downstream branch decays 25% faster, quarantining the fable of borrowed reputation before it spreads.
